description: The Niue Statistics Office publishes the report of the 2022 Census of Population and Housing on its census page. Chapter five covers households and housing in 31 tables. They give roof, wall and floor materials for 513 dwellings (metal roofs, wood or masonite and concrete walls, a small count of asbestos walls), rooms, intentions to renovate or build, toilets, fuel for cooking and hot water, where solar was the most common hot water source at 47 percent, and water sources including household tanks and bottled water. Other tables cover vehicles by fuel type, household appliances, internet connections and providers, waste disposal by village, dwellings by occupancy and derelict dwellings by village; household counts by village run from 2011. A short Households and Dwellings summary and one-page village highlights sit on the same page. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF, no registration. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: most housing tables are national totals only, and the village highlights read cover demographics, not housing. Simulation uses: building materials and water tank reliance for cyclone and drought exposure on a small island. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts with electricity access.
